headline_stat.name: POST vs PRE significant replay fraction (Fisher exact)

justification.dataset: Uses the canonical Buzsáki CA1 linear-track Achilles session (000044), the standard dataset for hippocampal replay.
justification.handling: Real remfile-streamed NWB data with correct units, cell-type filtering, Non-REM restriction, and carefully defined run bouts.
justification.analysis: Poisson Bayesian decoding with posterior-weighted correlation, per-event cell-ID shuffle null, circular-shift SI selection, and a PRE biological control that validates null calibration.
justification.correctness: All reported numbers (place-cell count, event counts, significant fractions, p-values) are internally consistent across README, code, and figures, with adequate sample sizes and sound tests.
justification.figures: Figures are readable, labeled with units and sample sizes, show a clean place-field template and unambiguous forward/reverse replay sweeps chosen by effect strength.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate and the PRE-at-chance control is stated, but the write-up gives no explicit limitations (single session, shuffle assumptions), capping a genuinely clean result at 3.
